Landlord: What about you? Any guests? Maybe over the weekend?
You: No, I don’t think so.
Landlord: Weird. I thought I heard some girl while I was passing by your door.
Shit!
Did he find out that I keep a sexbot in my room? Is that why he wanted to go home together? To interrogate me?
You: N-no, there was no girl in my room as of late. Must have been tv or something.
Landlord: I see.
Landlord: And here I thought you turned your life around! Hahahaha!
This fucker…
